messages:
maria: Quick sync  were planning the release announcement Tuesday AM. Need: final changelog URL, canonical docs link, concise benchmark blurb for social, webinar CTA copy, and the canary start window so we can time the email send. @aj @noah @sara

aj: Changelog draft is ready internally. Ill publish public link by EOD and post here. ETA 18:00 PT.

noah: Docs updates are merged to main; we need ops to flip the redirect. Proposed canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-05. Ops, can you flip at 08:45 PT on release day?

ops-lead: We can flip at 08:45 PT and monitor for 30m. Will post status via deploy-bot. Rollout plan: 08:55 PT canary at 10% for 20m, then 30% for 20m, full ramp 09:35 PT. Rollback triggers: p95 > 300ms or error > 1% sustained 3m.

sara: CTA options: "See benchmark results + register for 5/12 webinar" or "Join our 5/12 webinar to see performance wins". Prefer the second. Need final copy by 15:00 today for email builds.

maria: Picked the second CTA. Marketing also needs a short benchmark blurb (one sentence) that is non-technical but specific. Any suggestions?

aj: How about: "Now up to 2.5x faster p95 with significant cost reduction on common chat workloads." I'll include a benchmark appendix link in the changelog.

noah: I'll add a short note to the docs about the canary and expected behavior during the announcement window. Also posting the Segment event payload sample for inbound routing: {"event":"release_may_signup","source":"announce_email","campaign":"may_release"} (ops/sales can wire webhooks).

maria: Perfect. Final checklist: changelog link by 18:00 (aj), docs redirect flip 08:45 PT (ops), canary start 08:55 PT staged ramp (ops), CTA copy locked (sara), benchmark blurb (aj). If all confirmed, marketing will schedule email at 09:45 PT and social at 10:00 PT.

aj: Confirmed, changelog on track.

noah: Confirmed, docs redirect scheduled.

sara: Confirmed, will post draft by 14:45 for a quick sign-off.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] docs-redirect job queued for 2026-05-12T15:45:00Z, canary-rollout job queued for 2026-05-12T15:55:00Z, monitoring hooks enabled.

maria: Thanks everyone 4aa keep updates in this thread if timing or links change.
